items.title: Samsung Expands Galaxy Buds Family with First Open-Ear Clip Design
items.summary: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on open-ear wireless earbuds that leave the ear canal open for situational awareness. Powered by the Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 Sound Platform with TwinBoost speakers, the buds offer up to 9.5 hours of playback, Gemini Live, head gestures and Audio Leakage Reduction. They launch in South Korea on October 27, 2026.

items.title: Noise Opens Pre-Booking for Master Buds Open Clip-On Earbuds in India
items.summary: Indian brand Noise has opened pre-bookings for the Master Buds Open, its first Sound by Bose clip-on open-ear TWS earbuds. The C-bridge design pairs a 10.8mm driver with Bose-tuned Dynamic EQ, 4-mic ENC and up to 28 hours of battery. Priced at an introductory Rs 7,999, they launch in India on October 23, 2026.

items.title: Bose Doubles Down on Open-Ear Audio with Ultra Open 2nd Gen and Sport Open
items.summary: Bose unveiled the Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) and the new Sport Open, widening its open-ear range from one flagship to two models. The $299 Ultra Open adds a redesigned driver, Cinema Mode, aptX Adaptive and 9-hour battery, while the $199 Sport Open targets workouts with IP54 and physical buttons. Both went on sale October 1, 2026.

items.title: Anker Puts Its THUS AI Chip into Every New Soundcore Earbud and Clip
items.summary: At IFA 2026 Anker introduced the THUS AI chip across its Soundcore lineup, including the AeroClip 2 and AeroClip 2 Pro open-ear clips and the Liberty Buds 2 in-ear TWS. The on-device neural chip powers ultra-clear calls, adaptive ANC and, on the Pro clip, one-tap meeting and call transcription. Products began shipping on September 22, 2026.

items.title: Omdia: Open-Ear Shipments Surge 12% as Traditional TWS Stalls
items.summary: New Omdia data shows global TWS shipments slipped 0.7% year over year to 82.1 million in Q2 2026, the first annual decline since 2023, while open wireless stereo grew 12% to 11.1 million units. Clip-on models made up 61% of OWS, Apple held 20.5% of TWS, and Shokz led OWS with 107.9% growth. Omdia forecasts OWS to nearly double to 90.5 million by 2030.

items.title: Sennheiser Launches Momentum True Wireless 5 in India with Replaceable Batteries
items.summary: Sennheiser brought the Momentum True Wireless 5 earbuds to India, priced at Rs 29,990 with sales starting October 1, 2026. The flagship TWS features 24-bit/96kHz TrueResponse drivers, Dolby Atmos head tracking, adaptive hybrid ANC and Bluetooth 6.0 with aptX Lossless. A standout feature is user-replaceable batteries in both earbuds and case for up to 40 hours of playback.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Review: Smaller, Smarter and Finally a Secure Fit
items.summary: The Sony WF-1000XM6 earns strong praise as a class-leading flagship true wireless earbuds, pairing AI-adaptive ANC, LDAC hi-res audio and a redesigned shell about 12% smaller than the XM5. Reviewers highlight the best-in-class transparency mode and Android codec support, while noting touch controls and premium pricing as the main trade-offs.

items.title: CMF Buds Pro 2 Review: A Smart Dial and 50dB ANC Beat Its Price
items.summary: CMF by Nothing's second-generation Buds Pro 2 pair a rotating smart dial on the case with 50dB adaptive hybrid ANC, an 11mm-plus-6mm dual driver and LDAC support. Third-party reviewers keep comparing the $59 value earbuds to tiers above, citing 43 hours of battery and Bluetooth 5.4 multipoint as highlights, with slightly bass-heavy default tuning as the main caveat.

items.title: Best Open-Ear Earbuds 2026: Seven Clip-On Picks That Keep You Aware
items.summary: A fresh buying guide ranks the best clip-on open-ear earbuds of October 2026, led by the Sony LinkBuds Clip and the new Bose Ultra Open 2nd Gen, with budget options such as the EarFun Clip 2 and the Shokz OpenDots 2 for battery life. The roundup notes clip-on models now dominate the fast-growing open-ear category thanks to comfort and situational awareness.

items.title: OnePlus Nord Buds 3r Adds Jade Mist Colour for India Festive Sales
items.summary: OnePlus expanded its best-selling Nord Buds 3r TWS earbuds in India with a new Jade Mist finish, on sale from October 8, 2026 at Rs 1,999 with a festive effective price of Rs 1,599. The budget earbuds keep 12.4mm titanium-coated drivers, up to 54 hours of battery, IP55 rating, Bluetooth 5.4 and 47ms low-latency gaming mode.
